svg.text: FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT · PART 2.0 — MEDICAL SCREENING & MONITORING
TIER 3 · article 2 of 15 · = KEY K4 FROM THE PART 1.0 CONSOLE

text.tspan: Before pin one: zero every gauge to yourself. Lab ranges are population averages — your baseline is the
only "normal" that means anything. Prep the sample or the numbers lie. Order the lifter-proof markers.
Sweep for what growth signals would feed. Seal the one sample you can never take again. Then monitor
like it matters — because bloodwork twice a year is monitoring in name only.

g.text: DOING THIS IN MALAYSIA · PRICED LIKE A PARTS LIST

svg.text: ZONE 1 · THE ZEROING GAUGE — SET YOUR ZERO WHILE HEALTHY

text.tspan: the one reading you cannot go back
and take later — before you suppress it.
knowing what to pay attention to decides the first
cycle — and every cycle after it.

svg.text: ZONE 2 · THE SAMPLE-PREP CHAIN — BAD PREP DOESN'T JUST LIE, IT PRESCRIBES

g.text: FAULT · FALSE E2 READING → AI CRANKED AGAINST A NUMBER THAT WAS NEVER REAL.
Bad prep doesn't just lie — it prescribes. The wrong number drove a real intervention.

svg.text: ZONE 3 · THE INSTRUMENT RACK — SIX BAYS, ONE HEADLINE MARKER EACH

text.tspan: where the real cost shows up first — orals crush HDL ·
ApoB = particle count, the one extra worth paying for

g.text: A LIFTER'S BODY JAMS THE STANDARD SENSORS —
GGT normal + AST/ALT high = muscle, not liver.
BAY 5 · HORMONES — THE BAY THAT MATTERS MOST
your "after" is meaningless without a complete "before"
vit D · B12 · zinc — the context channels

svg.text: ZONE 4 · THE GROWTH-SIGNAL INTERLOCK — SWEEP BEFORE GH / IGF-1

text.tspan: fine print: baseline GH / LH / FSH /

svg.text: ZONE 5 · THE ARCHIVAL SAMPLE — THE ONLY READING WITH AN EXPIRY

text.tspan: a verified backup of the system state, stored

g.text: multiple samples · MORE THAN ONE CLINIC.

text.tspan: the one measurement you cannot go back and take —
take it before pin one, or never have it at all.

svg.text: ZONE 6 · THE INSPECTION TIMETABLE — MONITORING NEVER ENDS

g.text: EVERY 6–12 MONTHS = MONITORING IN NAME ONLY.
hematocrit at stroke territory · HDL near zero · 150/95 sitting quietly.

svg.text: Gauges zeroed, archive sealed, timetable set? Part 2.1 adds the continuous film. Part 3.0 opens the toolbox.
Harm reduction, not encouragement. Lab interpretation belongs with a physician — ideally one who knows what you're running.

Hematocrit & phlebotomy thresholds — AAS harm-reduction literature · MY lab pricing — BP Healthcare / Gribbles / Pathlab / hospital screening packages, 2026.
